en:
Yeah, you can't hear anything at all while
you're inside the map loading point.
Whoops, my hand slipped.

The rocks that the signboard got caught on
weren't on the chapel side of the map...
They were on the mansion side.

Nyeeeh...what about it? It just got washed
away from the chapel to the mansion, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>From the chapel to the mansion?
That's odd...
<CLT=cltMIND>The flow of the river...

This is toilet paper, right?
Why would it be in a place like this...?
Kaito Momota...
He logged out. Just as I thought.

There was a hammer, cell phone, and lattice
next to the chapel wall, but...

They're too light to make that loud sound.
It must have been from Miu hitting the wall.

Since the mansion was on top of a hill, the
roof was pretty high up, right?

Past the brick handrail, the roof
was at a pretty steep slope...

And the slope faced the chapel wall.
On top of that, there was snow on the roof.
Oh! Shuichi and Tsumugi!

Gonta, did you see Keebo around
here anywhere?
N-No, Gonta not see him.
Is this...<CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

It looks like it... Maybe the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the
outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL> is hidden in it?
We gotta tell everyone!
Wait!

Are you sure you wanna believe a liar like
me so easily?
...Huh?

This might be a trap, y'know? Shouldn't
you check if I'm lying first?

I mean...you wanna protect everyone, right?
This is the perfect time to do it.
P-Protect everyone...?
Huh? Kaito's not here?
Y-Yeah...you're right.

Oh man, I'm honored you asked me to meet up
with you, Miu. Is this a booty call...?
...Or are you here to kill me?

S-So...you figured it out.
But there's nothing you can do.

You...can't resist me. I made sure of it
when I programmed your settings.
Uh-ohhhh! Guess I'm in trouble now!

I-I'm sorry, but...you should just give up.
This is...my only chance.
I have no choice but to do this...

My inventions will change the world...
They'll make the world a better place!

It's my duty as a genius inventor!
S-So, I can't afford to die here—
S-Sorry...! Gonta so sorry...!

Don't be sorry, Gonta. She was trying to
kill me, too.

She said it was for the world or whatever,
but that was just a poor excuse.

We're doing this to stop the vicious cycle of
misery! So you don't need to apologize.
B-But...but...!
Ergh...nrgh...! Gonta sorry!
Gonta so sorry, Miu!

I already said you don't need to apologize.
We had to do this for everyone's sake.
Whoops, my hand slipped.

She dropped the bridge on purpose, so she
could separate the chapel from the mansion...

Then secretly passed through the wall she
installed, and took advantage of the loop.

After, she headed to where we were supposed
to meet up—the mansion's rooftop.

Oh yeah...Kaito was probably logged out
around that time, too.
That's when I saw Miu...

After the culprit killed Miu on the rooftop,
they placed her corpse on a sled...
...and slid her down the roof's steep slope!

The sled picked up speed,
flew off the roof...

glided through the wall <CLT=cltSTRONG>only objects
could pass through<CLT=cltNORMAL>, and hit the chapel.
